# Lab 20.7: Labels for Cost Attribution

## What We Are Going to Do
Label jobs and datasets, then report cost by team from the JOBS view.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Run queries with job labels.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --label=team:marketing --label=report:weekly \
  'SELECT traffic_source, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` GROUP BY 1'
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --label=team:finance \
  'SELECT status, SUM(sale_price) FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` GROUP BY 1'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Label a query in the console.** Labels can be set in a script with a system variable:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SET @@query_label = 'team:data-science,report:adhoc';
SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` GROUP BY category;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[CLI] Label datasets.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq update --set_label=team:finance lab20
bq update --set_label=team:finance lab20_billing</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Dataset labels show up in billing export for storage costs.

4. **[SQL] Cost by team.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT l.value AS team, COUNT(*) AS queries,
       ROUND(SUM(total_bytes_billed) / POW(1024, 4) * 6.25, 4) AS est_cost_usd
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_PROJECT, UNNEST(labels) AS l
WHERE l.key = 'team' AND creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY team;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Job labels | `--label` or `@@query_label` |
| Dataset labels | Storage cost by team |
| Report | Cost per team from JOBS |
| Strategy | Agree on label keys across the company |
